content.text: {"id": "mm5549a4", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "vaccination coverage with 1 or more doses varied widely (range: 6.6% to 60.4%) among sites"}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Vaccination coverage with 1 or more doses among children aged 6--23 months ranged from 6.6% to 60.4%"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Percentages of children who were fully vaccinated ranged from 2.3% to 43.4%."}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "vaccination coverage with 1 or more doses increased at four sentinel sites and decreased at two sites"}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "surveillance/descriptive", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "This report assesses influenza vaccination coverage among children aged 6--23 months during the 2005--06 influenza season"}]}, {"v": "before/after or trend", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Compared with the 2004--05 influenza season ( 2 ), vaccination coverage with 1 or more doses increased at four sentinel sites"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Vaccination coverage was estimated for September 1, 2005--March 31, 2006, among children who were aged 6--23 months during the entire period"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Children were considered fully vaccinated if they had 1) received no dose of influenza vaccine before September 1, 2005, but then received 2 doses"}], "confidence": "medium", "uncertain_fields": ["study_design"]}
